properties.name: Clickup · ClickUp Delivery command platform
properties.description: ClickUp's delivery director, implementation leads, resource manager and consultants run every customer implementation from one code app: portfolio health at a glance, a project workspace, resourcing and timesheets, change requests that route by an hours rule, a weekly executive summary and Delivery Copilot, a read-only AI assistant over the live data. Customer sponsors follow and sign off their own rollout in a portal in English, German and Japanese; consultants log time from a phone view. The story follows IMP-2611 Sakura Mobility, at risk of missing its 19 Nov 2026 go-live. This plan (part 1 of 10) builds the data layer: Project, Task, RAID item, Person, Booking, Time entry, Change request, Activity, Document, Session slot.
